title: Monitor
description: How this server and its services are holding up.

empty.title: Nothing is running
empty.description: Live CPU, memory and network figures appear here once services are running.

unavailable: Docker isn't answering, so there's nothing to show right now.

gauges.label: Server readings
gauges.title: Server
gauges.networkScope: Traffic of all containers on this server

settings.title: Chart settings
settings.rangeHint: Older periods are stored at a coarser step.
settings.stepHint: The spacing between a trend's points.
settings.refreshHint: How often the gauges read new values.

events.emptyDescription: Docker's events appear here as they happen, newest first.

storage.emptyDescription: Each service's data directory appears here with its size.
storage.dockerDiskUnknown: Docker's disk can't be measured from here.

restricted.title: Administrators only
restricted.description: Monitoring shows the whole server, so it's reserved for administrators.

tableScope: Each row adds up its running tasks, read from Docker. Network columns count from each task's start.
historyScope: Averaged over each interval. An interval with no reading is left blank, never counted as zero.

kept.title: Kept volumes
kept.description: Volumes left behind by destroyed services. They hold their data until you delete them here, one at a time.
kept.deleteDescription: You are about to delete the data in
kept.removed: This volume and everything it holds. There is no undo.
kept.keptStill: Backups of the service it came from, and every other volume.
